settings.label: Look up simplified characters in traditional
settings.description: Also look words up with simplified characters written in traditional characters (说 → 說, 头发 → 頭髮), for dictionaries that list words only in traditional characters. Not needed with CC-CEDICT, which lists both, and it shows duplicate entries there.

settings.label: Look up traditional characters in simplified
settings.description: Also look words up with traditional characters written in simplified characters (說 → 说), for dictionaries that list words only in simplified characters. Not needed with CC-CEDICT, which lists both, and it shows duplicate entries there.

recommendedDictionaries.name: CC-CEDICT for Yomitan
recommendedDictionaries.description: Chinese–English from CC-CEDICT: every word under its simplified and its traditional spelling, with pinyin.

recommendedDictionaries.name: wty-zh-en (wiktionary-to-yomitan)
recommendedDictionaries.description: Chinese–English from English Wiktionary through kaikki.org: more words, with examples, characters and dialect words. Words in simplified characters point to their traditional entries.

recommendedDictionaries.name: CC-CEDICT Hanzi for Yomitan
recommendedDictionaries.description: Single characters with their pinyin and meanings, for the character view.
